objective: Compare the existing CSI300 point-in-time stock-selection strategy with a self-defined, point-in-time Shanghai/Shenzhen A-share tradable universe while keeping factors, fusion, portfolio and costs unchanged.

data.st_history_source: namechange effective intervals because dedicated st endpoint is unavailable for the supplied account

universe.base: all historically listed Shanghai and Shenzhen A shares returned by stock_basic L/D/P
universe.held_suspension_policy: execution layer retains and values an existing suspended position; universe eligibility only blocks a new selection

pre_registered_questions: Does the custom-universe Top50 outperform its own weekly equal-weight custom-universe benchmark?
Does changing only the universe improve or weaken the Top50 strategy relative to the CSI300 point-in-time control?
Does the conclusion remain directionally stable at ADV20 thresholds of CNY30m and CNY100m?
How much universe turnover and portfolio turnover are introduced by the custom eligibility rules?
forbidden_actions: choose the ADV threshold after viewing returns
add a market-cap filter after viewing returns
add profitability or financial-quality filters to improve results
change factor signs family weights top_k or evaluation dates after viewing results
use current stock or ST status to overwrite historical eligibility
treat the retrospective result as true forward evidence
approve live trading from this experiment
